csv_project_name: Project Development For Traffic Signals Modernization
csv_agency: State of IN Department of Transportation
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Indiana, Department of Transportation, may be seeking a consultant to provide preliminary engineering and plan development services necessary to produce construction contract documents in accordance with the INDOT project development process. The selected firm shall complete Traffic Signal Design, Road Design (if needed), Survey, Environmental documentation (including any permits), Right of Way Engineering, Utility coordination and Construction Phase Services. Other services such as, Ecological Surveys, Archeological Investigations, Historical/Architectural Investigation, professional public outreach and marketing services, and Wetland Mitigation may be added later if these services become necessary. Pavement Design, Geotechnical Engineering and Real Estate Services will be performed by INDOT if needed. The INDOT Project Manager and the Consultant will schedule the Scoping Meeting within two (2) weeks of the Notice of Selection. The selected firm's fee proposal shall be due 45 calendar days after the selection date for this RFP item. The contract may utilize the INDOT eInvoice application.

title: Project Development for Traffic Signals Modernization
short_description: Consulting services for traffic signal modernization design and related roadway project development.
project_scope: Project development for traffic signals modernization under INDOT procedures. Scope includes preliminary engineering and plan development to produce construction contract documents. Services cover traffic signal design, road design if needed, survey, environmental documentation and permits, right-of-way engineering, utility coordination, and construction phase services. Additional optional tasks may include ecological surveys, archaeological investigations, historical/architectural investigation, public outreach and marketing services, and wetland mitigation. Pavement design, geotechnical engineering, and real estate services will be performed by INDOT if needed.
services: Preliminary engineering; plan development; traffic signal design; road design if needed; surveying; environmental documentation and permitting; right-of-way engineering; utility coordination; construction phase services.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a traffic signals modernization and roadway project, not a bridge, special structure, stadium, or complex building.
- Scope focuses on civil/traffic engineering, environmental documentation, survey, and utility coordination.
- No indication of significant structural design, long spans, lightweight structures, or architecturally demanding components.
- Includes many services outside sbp's core profile and no clear structural engineering opportunity.
fee_explanation: No explicit fee information provided. Only total construction cost of 3.5 million USD is stated.
references_qualifications: Consultant sought for project development under INDOT process with capabilities in traffic signal design, road design, survey, environmental documentation, right-of-way engineering, utility coordination, and construction phase services. No specific minimum reference counts or qualification thresholds are stated in the notice.

notes: Advance notice only. RFQ/RFP package expected before 2026-08-01. Project #: 860223-1. Item ID: 21740. DES.NO: 2600079. Project No: 2607. Fee proposal due 45 calendar days after selection date. Category assigned by closest available fixed list, although the project is actually a traffic signals/streets-highways assignment rather than a bridge project.
